title: Gauravaneeyuda Galaliyavada – Sireesha Telugu Christian Lyrics

english: Geethamu raasi, raagamu koorchi, gaanamu chesi ninu sthuthiyinchi

1. Enchi choosthe ee manchi ledu naalo

intro: Gauravaneeyuda Galaliyavada is the latest Telugu worship song written by John Sandeep, tuned Kiran, sung by Sireesha Bhagavatula and music composed by JK Christopher . This song video was released on July 04, 2025, through their YouTube channel BETHESDA BETHEL MINISTRIES, inviting listeners into a powerful and immersive worship encounter.
